HMPV virus can be sneaky, but a little care goes a long way. Protect yourself and your loved ones by staying informed and taking the right precautions. 💡

🧴 Sanitize often.
😷 Mask up when needed.
🚶‍♂️ Keep your distance in crowded spaces.
